record.body:
## Rationale

Contract-only change in se-workflow. No migration: records without the field read as open. The extension stays untouched, which AGENTS.md in adaptive-artifacts gates behind human approval.

## Counter-argument

Lifecycle state no longer tells the whole story: a closed goal is still lifecycle `active`, so any reader that filters by lifecycle alone shows it.

payload.alternatives: active-goal on the commitment pattern; a closed lifecycle state in adaptive-artifacts current-claim trait
payload.choice: optional status field on goal and position, superseded to closed

record.subject: goal-close-mechanism
